classification.summary: Burner.convertAndBurn() is permissionless and swaps the contract's accumulated USDT/WBTC into PNT through Uniswap V2 with a zero minimum-output, so the whole conversion could be sandwiched by pre-buying and re-selling PNT in the same transaction.
